description: Updates an existing row or inserts a new row in the Helix Ultimate layout builder (synced with Joomla database). Enforces Bootstrap 12-column grid rule.

columns.description: Array of columns. Total sum of widths must equal exactly 12.

customClass.description: Optional CSS class for the column

isComponent.description: Set to true if this column renders the main Joomla component body

insertAbove.description: Insert this row immediately above the named row (e.g. "Header")

insertBelow.description: Insert this row immediately below the named row

rowId.description: Unique name or numeric index of the row to update (e.g. "Main Body", "Header", "0")

rowSettings.description: Optional row settings (fluidrow, custom_class, name, etc.)

styleId.description: Optional Joomla template style ID to modify

template.description: Optional template folder name (e.g. "shaper_helixultimate", "shaper_educon"). Defaults to active Helix template.

name: helix_update_row
